screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows a molecule in 3D and its infrared transmittance spectrum. Each dip is a normal mode of vibration.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area chooses the molecule, substitutes isotopes, sets the line width and toggles the normal-mode sticks and functional-group regions. For hydrogen chloride it also shows the rotational fine structure of the gas, with a temperature slider.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Focus the spectrum and use the arrow keys to step through the peaks; the molecule vibrates in the selected mode.

infrared.spectrumHelp: Click a dip, or use the arrow keys, to select a vibration.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows a molecule in 3D with its hydrogens lettered (or carbons numbered) by environment, its proton or carbon-13 NMR spectrum, a zoom on one signal, and a table of signals.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area chooses the molecule, the observed nucleus and the spectrometer frequency. For protons it toggles a D₂O shake, the TMS reference, the integral and the exact second-order simulation; for carbon it chooses a decoupled, DEPT or coupled spectrum.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Focus the spectrum and use the arrow keys to step through the signals, or activate a row in the signal list. The matching hydrogens are ringed.

nmr.spectrumHelp: Click a peak, or use the arrow keys, to select a signal.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows a conjugated molecule with one π orbital drawn as red and blue lobes, its π energy levels filled with electrons, and the predicted and measured absorption bands with the colour each would give.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area chooses the molecule and the model, Hückel or particle in a box, and turns on the Beer–Lambert mode with concentration and path-length sliders.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Compare the predicted and measured wavelengths along a family, for example the cyanine dyes with each model.

uvVis.levelsHelp: Use the arrow keys to choose the orbital drawn on the molecule.
uvVis.quantitativeDetails: At {{concentration}} micromoles per litre in a {{pathLength}} centimetre cell, the spectrometer reads absorbance {{absorbance}} at the maximum.

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows the infrared and proton or carbon-13 NMR spectra of an unknown molecule, its formula, degree of unsaturation and molecular ion, and buttons for the candidate isomers.
screenSummary.controlArea: The control area chooses the level, starts a new unknown, and switches the NMR spectrum between proton and carbon-13.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Read the spectra, then press the button of the molecule you think it is.
